Ayushman Bharat Scheme Marks 8 Years, Covers 60 Crore People

The Ayushman Bharat scheme has completed eight years of operation. Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that the scheme has provided health cover of Rs 5 lakh to 60 crore people. The Mizoram BJP chief credited the scheme with transforming healthcare in India.
